From 5875781c52e030c221fcf9a04f2bde3c8075fe4f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Josh Elser <elserj@apache.org>
Date: Sun, 22 Jun 2014 17:16:26 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] ACCUMULO-2935 Add a timeout to a test that otherwise hung
 indefinitely


diff --git a/test/src/test/java/org/apache/accumulo/test/MetaSplitIT.java b/test/src/test/java/org/apache/accumulo/test/MetaSplitIT.java
index 6d059212a6..4ea2663740 100644
--- a/test/src/test/java/org/apache/accumulo/test/MetaSplitIT.java
+++ b/test/src/test/java/org/apache/accumulo/test/MetaSplitIT.java
@@ -31,7 +31,7 @@ import org.junit.Test;
 
 public class MetaSplitIT extends SimpleMacIT {
 
-  @Test(expected = AccumuloException.class)
+  @Test(expected = AccumuloException.class, timeout = 30000)
   public void testRootTableSplit() throws Exception {
     TableOperations opts = getConnector().tableOperations();
     SortedSet<Text> splits = new TreeSet<Text>();
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `MetaSplitIT.java`**
   - The `@Test` annotation for the method `testRootTableSplit` was modified to include a `timeout` parameter. The timeout was set to 30,000 milliseconds (30 seconds). This change ensures that if the test does not complete within this time frame, it will fail instead of hanging indefinitely.

### Relationships
- The modification in `MetaSplitIT.java` addresses a bug related to a test that could hang indefinitely. By adding a timeout to the test, the patch improves the reliability of the test suite by preventing it from stalling, thus allowing for better test management and quicker feedback during the testing process.

Here is the commit message:
ACCUMULO-2935 Add a timeout to a test that otherwise hung
 indefinitely

Here is the root cause:
The test `testRootTableSplit` in `MetaSplitIT.java` was hanging indefinitely due to a lack of a timeout, which prevented it from failing gracefully when it encountered issues during execution. This could be caused by various factors such as deadlocks, resource contention, or unresponsive components in the system under test.

Here is the patch:
 
-  @Test(expected = AccumuloException.class)
+  @Test(expected = AccumuloException.class, timeout = 30000)
   public void testRootTableSplit() throws Exception {
     TableOperations opts = getConnector().tableOperations();
     SortedSet<Text> splits = new TreeSet<Text>();
     splits.add(new Text("5"));
     opts.addSplits(RootTable.NAME, splits);
   }
